design_philosophy.overview: A highly immersive, cinematic, and minimalist presentation letter for a premium photography studio. Focus on negative space, typography as art, and optical clarity via glassmorphism.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large editorial statements, massive hero text. Use tracking-tight (-0.02em) for large sizes.

secondary_body.usage: Prices, paragraphs, nav links, micro-copy, UI elements. High legibility, geometric, tracking-wide for overlines (0.2em).

glassmorphism_treatment.optical_clarity: Use backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%). This ensures colors behind the glass pop and don't look muddy.
glassmorphism_treatment.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) on the top/left to simulate light catching the edge, and rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) on bottom/right.
glassmorphism_treatment.hover_state: Increase background to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) and border to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transform translate-y slightly.

micro_interactions.custom_cursor: A minimalist white dot (4px) that expands to a 40px glass circle (backdrop-filter) when hovering over images, displaying a subtle 'VER' text.
micro_interactions.scroll_engine: Lenis.js for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. Crucial for the immersive feel.
micro_interactions.entrance_animations: GSAP ScrollTrigger for fading in elements slightly from below as they enter the viewport. Staggered text reveals.
micro_interactions.image_parallax: Images in the portfolio section should have a subtle parallax effect on scroll (image translates Y within its hidden overflow container).

layout_sections.name: Hero
layout_sections.structure: Asymmetrical layout. Massive 'OTRA VAINA' overlapping an editorial photo on the right. Left side contains the brand intro. Floating glass navigation bar at top.
layout_sections.immersive_detail: Subtle animated film grain overlay (via CSS noise) on the entire background.

layout_sections.name: Services (List to Image Reveal)
layout_sections.structure: A stark, minimalist vertical list of services in large Outfit font. No grid.
layout_sections.immersive_detail: Hovering over a service name reveals its corresponding image in a floating glass frame that loosely follows the mouse position.

layout_sections.name: Process (Sticky/Horizontal)
layout_sections.immersive_detail: As the user scrolls, the cards stack on top of each other using GSAP pinning, or scroll horizontally. Each card is a pristine glassmorphism block.

layout_sections.name: Portfolio / Catálogo
layout_sections.structure: Bento-style asymmetric grid, strictly NOT a standard masonry. Mix large, medium, and tall image blocks.
layout_sections.immersive_detail: Filter links at the top (Editorial, Estudio, Conceptual, Familia). Images have a dark overlay that clears on hover. Custom cursor expands here.

layout_sections.name: About & Stats
layout_sections.structure: Centered editorial typography statement. Below it, a 3-column grid of glass modules for stats (250+ proyectos, 180+ clientes, 5+ años).
layout_sections.immersive_detail: Numbers counter animate up on scroll.

layout_sections.name: Investment Plans (Planes)
layout_sections.structure: 4 pricing tiers in a grid or horizontal scroll track. Cards use the signature glass treatment.
layout_sections.immersive_detail: A subtle gradient glow sweeps across the border of the cards on hover. 'Desde RD$' in secondary text.

layout_sections.name: Footer / Contact
layout_sections.structure: 100vh height. Huge 'HABLEMOS' text that fills the screen width.
layout_sections.immersive_detail: A prominent floating glass button for WhatsApp (+1 809 268 0341) that pulses softly. Links to IG (@otravainaestudios).

technical_instructions.file_structure: Everything must be in a single /app/index.html file (HTML, CSS in <style>, JS in <script>).
technical_instructions.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-fab', data-testid='filter-editorial', data-testid='plan-booking-button').
technical_instructions.responsiveness: Mobile-first approach. Ensure glassmorphism is performant on mobile.
